title: Keep conflicting Codex delta locator invalidation sticky through reported end
outcome: A locator rejected after a conflict or overflow cannot regain exact native correlation when a later provider end overwrites runtime output flags.
acceptance: Conflicting or overflowed delta locator ingress remains invalid when a later Codex finished end arrives.
A conflicting-then-finished regression preserves honest original custody and refuses exact run correlation; valid locator behavior remains covered.
